answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. The way a juniper roots the soil, a echo returns each spring, and a jetty reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
